text_block_list.text:
Найс Нэйчер manages to beat Токай Тэйо
in the
Japanese Derby.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
However, when she sees Токай Тэйо
retain a
positive outlook for the next
race despite losing,
Найс Нэйчер is
stunned by their difference in
outlooks.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
